column1: # inn_rc_oct24 arms of job 1, read by submit_inn_rc_oct24.sbatch when the job STARTS (edit here, in place, before it
# starts). Columns (tab-separated, 4): index, arm, flags beyond common.args ('-' = none; later flags win), the arm's share
# of the card's memory (--cuda_memory_fraction; 0.3 of an 80 GB A100 = 24 GB). Both arms run at once on one A100 under
# MPS. Each arm holds its prior on the card for the whole run: the qm9rc-only prior (1,120,750 rows, 114,817 molecules)
# ran at 13.4 GB on a 16 GB card locally; the all-family prior has 6.0x its rows (6,675,860) and 5.9x its molecules
# (681,553), many of them larger, and the all-family set thinned to 3 rows per molecule ran out at 14.6 GB locally.
#   rcq        qm9rc only: the qm9full SMILES, one random conformer each (the control)
#   rcall      every family of installment 1: qm9rc + csdrc + zincrc + gdbrc + pubrc
# Every arm is scored on the same held-out set (common.args: the qm9rc held-out molecules). Job 2 (arms_big.tsv)
# runs rcall_big on its own card.
